title: Upcoming marathons and running events in Kochi
description: Compare upcoming full and half marathons, 10K races and shorter runs around Kochi, with registration links.
intro: A source-checked calendar of announced running events in Kochi and the surrounding Ernakulam area. It includes full and half marathons as well as shorter races and family runs; a shorter run is not necessarily a marathon. Dates, venues and registration can change, so confirm with the organizer before making plans.

entries.name: Alhuda Marathon 2026 (near Kochi)
entries.venue: Alhuda Public School, Panayikulam, Ernakulam (near Kochi)
entries.description: The school lists a 21 km half marathon, 10 km run and 3 km family run in Panayikulam, outside Kochi city. Its published registration deadline was 20 October; confirm current availability with the organizer.

entries.name: Orange Run 2026
entries.venue: Cochin Port Trust Stadium, Willingdon Island
entries.description: The registration provider says registration is closed and disables its final registration button. Some 5 km category controls are still visible; check with the organizer if you need clarification.

entries.name: RCI Run & Ride 2026
entries.description: The event offers a 21 km timed run, 10 km run, 5 km fun run and 5 km walk; it also has a separate 50 km cycling category. The registration page provides category-specific details and fees.

entries.name: Team QR Mini Marathon / Season 5
entries.description: Team QR Kochi lists this 10 km event on its registration page, which says entries are filling up. A virtual option is also mentioned, with its date to be announced separately.

entries.name: Santa Run Kochi 2026
entries.venue: Lulu Bolgatty International Convention Centre, Kochi
entries.description: The Rotary Club of Cochin Knights Trust lists a half marathon, 10 km run and 5 km fun run. Its registration page says entries are open; confirm current availability before paying.

entries.name: SBI Kochi Navy Half Marathon 2026
entries.venue: Start: Grand Hyatt Convention Center; finish: Bolgatty Palace Ground
entries.description: Organized by Southern Naval Command, this event has a half marathon, timed 10 km run and 5 km fun run. The published flag-off times are provisional, and the route map is to be released closer to race day.

entries.name: Zydus Pinkathon Kochi 2027
entries.venue: Kochi; exact venue to be announced
entries.description: The organizer lists a Kochi edition of its women’s run for 10 January. Kochi-specific distances and registration have not yet been confirmed; the Mumbai page’s details may not apply.

entries.name: Devils Circuit Kochi 2027
entries.venue: Kochi; exact venue to be confirmed
entries.description: A 5 km obstacle-course race, rather than a conventional road run. The registration provider shows non-competitive waves C and D as sold out, while other waves are available; confirm your chosen wave and the venue before booking.

entries.name: Federal Bank Kochi Marathon 2027
entries.venue: Kochi; exact venue and route to be confirmed
entries.description: The organizer lists a full marathon, half marathon, timed 10 km and 3 km Green Run. Registration is open for all four categories. The route has not yet been finalized; verify the race venue before booking travel.

entries.name: Nammude Run Kochi 2027
entries.description: The organizer lists children’s runs, a walkathon and both timed and fun-run options. Confirm the age rules, fee and availability for your chosen category.

ordering.explanation: Upcoming events are ordered by date, earliest first. Events on the same date keep their editorial order; undated events appear last.
